name: Copy when traders agree
summary: Copy an outcome on paper once 2 of the traders you follow bought it within 6 hours.
description:
One trader can be wrong; two buying the same outcome is a stronger sign. This workflow copies a buy only when your traders agree: once 2 of those you follow bought the same outcome within 6 hours, the buy that makes two is copied, and each one after it in those 6 hours. A buy no one else made leaves from alone, not copied.

Sells are copied as they come, as in Copy traders: a copy is sold when the trader it copied sells, so it never outstays them.

It copies on paper, $10 a buy, within the limits of Copy traders: at most $50 in one market and $200 a day, and no buys under 0.05 or over 0.95.

- Fill in the traders to follow, two or more, then switch Active on.
- Consensus remembers who bought what for 6 hours, across restarts; its settings say how much, with Forget.
- The Trading view shows how it does: each trader's profit and loss, what it holds, and every order.

nodes.name: Traders to follow
nodes.notes: Starts the workflow with each trade one of your traders makes. Switch a trader off in the table to stop copying them and keep their row.

nodes.name: A sell?
nodes.notes: Sells go straight on, so a copy is sold when its trader sells; buys wait for agreement.

nodes.name: 2 agree
nodes.notes: Lets a buy on once another of your traders bought the same outcome in the 6 hours before it. Buys no one else made leave from alone.
Works out the order that copies the trade: $10 for a buy, the same share of what it holds for a sell, at their price or at most 2 cents worse.
Keeps buys within your limits: $50 in one market, $200 a day, prices from 0.05 to 0.95. A copy over a cap goes ahead smaller; one a limit stops goes out of blocked. Sells always go ahead.
Places the copy on paper, against the live order book: what the book has within the price fills at once, the rest is cancelled.
